finalText:
Migrated 36 calls across 12 files to `db.execute({ sql, params })`. All 78 files pass `node --check`. The 25 `cache.query` calls are a different object and were left alone.

I skipped `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js`, which still has 2 `db.query` calls. Its header says it is a vendored copy replaced wholesale on upgrade, so edits there get silently lost. Fixing it needs an upstream change or a local wrapper.

| Area | Files changed |
|---|---|
| accounts | `apiKeyAdmin.js`, `session.js`, `teamService.js` |
| analytics | `cohort.js` |
| billing | `couponService.js`, `refund.js` |
| catalog | `supplier.js`, `variantAdmin.js` |
| orders | `returnService.js`, `shipment.js` |
| support | `sla.js`, `macroAdmin.js` |
